chapters.title: BFS, allowing None into the queue

frames.caption: BFS, allowing None into the queue — O(n) time, O(w) extra space. Input: is_complete(root=tree (1)). Step through to watch the code work on this input.
node = queue.popleft() — (1) taken from the front of queue
node = queue.popleft() — (2) taken from the front of queue; node moves to (2)
node = queue.popleft() — (3) taken from the front of queue; node moves to (3)
node = queue.popleft() — (4) taken from the front of queue; node moves to (4)
node = queue.popleft() — (5) taken from the front of queue; node moves to (5)
node = queue.popleft() — None taken from the front of queue; node = None
node = queue.popleft() — (7) taken from the front of queue; node moves to (7)
return False — returns F (a real node after a gap). Result: F

chapters.title: Index-based DFS

frames.caption: Index-based DFS — O(n) time, O(h) extra space. Input: is_complete(root=tree (1)). Step through to watch the code work on this input.
return 1 + lc + rc, max(index, li, ri) — tally returns (1, 4) to tally; node moves to (4); index = 4; rc = 0; ri = 0
return 1 + lc + rc, max(index, li, ri) — tally returns (1, 5) to tally; node moves to (5); index = 5; rc = 0; ri = 0
return 1 + lc + rc, max(index, li, ri) — tally returns (3, 5) to tally; node moves to (2); index = 2; lc = 1; li = 4; …
return 1 + lc + rc, max(index, li, ri) — tally returns (1, 7) to tally; node moves to (7); index = 7; rc = 0; ri = 0
return 1 + lc + rc, max(index, li, ri) — tally returns (2, 7) to tally; node moves to (3); index = 3; rc = 1; ri = 7
return 1 + lc + rc, max(index, li, ri) — tally returns (6, 7) to is_complete; node moves to (1); index = 1; lc = 3; li = 5; …
